title: "Trial-Forged Bonds"
next_chapter_hook: "When Chen Ji was helped by Su Qingyao onto the return path, he suddenly felt the turtle shell in his embrace grow scalding hot—it was the Tianji Record Fragment sending a warning: above the cliff, a pair of eyes was watching everything."

text.content:
"Night dyed in ink, mountain winds wailing. Chen Ji gripped the turtle shell in his arms, its web-like cracks flickering in an eerie rhythm, as if transmitting some unspeakable warning. His brow center twitched slightly—the Tianji Record had never warned so intensely before.

But he had no time to think further. Behind him came deliberately heavy footsteps, accompanied by a voice dripping with provocation: 'Oh, isn't this the 'useless servant' of the Tianqing Sect? What are you doing alone at the Cliff Edge this late at night?'

Chen Ji slowly turned around, his face wearing its usual timorous expression. Under the moonlight, Han Lie's arrogant features were clearly visible, with two Xuanwu Sect disciples behind him, all wearing expressions of watching a good show."

dialogue.content: "Han Lie crossed his arms, a playful smile hanging at the corner of his mouth: 'Chen Ji, do you know the Sect Competition is tomorrow? A servant disciple like you, not hiding in your own nest, coming here to catch cold air—is it that you want to practice how to fall off the platform in advance?' The two disciples behind burst into laughter at his words."

text.content:
"Chen Ji drooped his eyelids, his shoulders trembling slightly, assuming a fearful posture. He knew he couldn't expose himself—at this moment, the turtle shell was vibrating frantically, the images from the Tianji Record vague and urgent, yet clearly showing a hand pushing toward his back.

'Han... Han Senior Brother, I just came here to get some fresh air, I'll leave now.' Chen Ji mumbled, his voice carrying just the right amount of tremor.

He deliberately slowed his pace, backing toward the Mountain Path while facing away from Han Lie. Back, and back more—just need to retreat behind that bush, and he could dodge by using the terrain."

dialogue.content:
"Han Lie narrowed his eyes, watching Chen Ji's cowering appearance, his malicious amusement growing ever stronger. He leisurely strolled forward. 'Since you're here, why leave in such a hurry?' Before the words finished, he suddenly quickened his pace. 'Come, let Senior Brother give you a hand—'

A fierce palm wind struck from behind Chen Ji!"

text.content:
"Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. The image from the Tianji Record flashed through his mind—he was prepared, his figure suddenly dodging to the side. However, Han Lie was, after all, the number one genius of the Xuanwu Sect; this palm came too fast, too fierce. Even though Chen Ji barely evaded the vital point, the residual palm wind still heavily struck his shoulder blade.

'Ah—!' Chen Ji's body staggered, the gravel beneath his feet rolling down the cliff one after another. He reached for a withered branch beside him, but his fingertips only touched empty void.

The sensation of weightlessness struck instantly.

Chen Ji fell into boundless darkness, his ears filled only with howling wind and Han Lie's fading wild laughter: 'Hahaha! Trash is still trash—even walking they can 'accidentally' slip!'"

"The withered branches on the cliff face were like blades, slicing across Chen Ji's face and arms, blood splashing. The turtle shell in his embrace suddenly erupted with scalding heat, seemingly forcibly urging some kind of power—the Tianji Record was drawing upon Heavenly Fate Value at the critical moment, fighting for his last sliver of chance.

Chen Ji felt his vision blur, and suddenly a white shadow appeared in his originally pitch-black field of vision. That white shadow leapt down from somewhere above the cliff,身形如鸿雁掠过夜空, robes fluttering as they descended, bringing with them a gust of biting cold fragrance.

'Who is that!' Chen Ji cried out in his weightless fall."

dialogue.content:
"'Don't move.' A cold, clear female voice rang beside his ear, carrying undeniable authority. The next instant, a slender yet powerful arm circled his waist, forcibly steadying his falling body.

Chen Ji opened his eyes, meeting a pair of eyes like an icy abyss. Under the moonlight, that coldly beautiful face was clearly visible—it was Su Qingyao, the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of the Tianqing Sect.

'Su... Su Senior Sister?' Chen Ji's face was full of shock, his voice carrying genuine confusion. He had never expected Su Qingyao to appear at such a place, at such a time."

text.content:
"Su Qingyao did not answer immediately. With one arm around Chen Ji's waist, her toes lightly tapped the protruding stones on the cliff face, her body as agile as a swallow, and in moments she brought Chen Ji down to the edge of a water pool at the cliff's base.

'Steady?' She released him, her voice still cold as frost.

Chen Ji stumbled to his feet, the wound on his shoulder sending burning pain, blood already staining half his garment. He lowered his head in thanks: 'Many thanks for Senior Sister Su's life-saving grace. If not for your coincidental passing by, I...' 

'There are no coincidences in my life.' Su Qingyao cut him off, her gaze微微一凝, 'Tell me, why would Han Lie try to kill you on the eve of the Sect Competition?'"

"Chen Ji forced a bitter smile, wearing a wronged and helpless expression: 'Senior Brother Han probably... finds me an eyesore. After all, to someone like him, a waste like me is just wasting the sect's food even by existing.'

Su Qingyao watched him silently, those icy abyss-like eyes seeming capable of seeing through all pretense. Chen Ji felt the weight of that gaze, his heart tightening slightly—he knew Su Qingyao was the only person in the entire Tianqing Sect who made him feel dangerous.

After a moment, Su Qingyao looked away, saying indifferently: 'Your injuries are not light. Follow me.'"

choice.prompt: "How should Chen Ji respond to Su Qingyao's inquiry and scrutinizing gaze?"

choices.text: "Continue playing dumb and putting on a pitiful act"
choices.description: "Maintain the usual waste persona, using more displays of weakness to dispel Su Qingyao's suspicions, but this might make her even more suspicious."
choices.risk_hint: "Su Qingyao has extremely strong observational skills; the disguise might be seen through"

text.content: "Chen Ji squeezed out a smile uglier than crying: 'Senior Sister jokes, what could a servant disciple like me possibly have that Senior Brother Han would target? Probably just that I accidentally got in his way.' As he spoke, he nonchalantly pressed his hand against the turtle shell in his embrace, concealing its faintly radiating warmth."

choices.description: "Slightly show some of his true self, testing Su Qingyao's reaction and establishing a more equal footing for dialogue."
choices.risk_hint: "Might trigger Su Qingyao to investigate more deeply"

text.content: "Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then suddenly let out a light laugh, that smile carrying a sharpness utterly different from before: 'Does Senior Sister truly believe I'm just a lamb for the slaughtering?' He raised his eyes, his gaze meeting Su Qingyao's. 'Han Lie will challenge me publicly at tomorrow's competition—he wants to make me 'accidentally' lose before the entire sect, so I'll never rise again.'"

choices.description: "Don't answer her question; instead, ask why she appears at the Cliff Edge late at night, shifting the focus."

text.content: "Chen Ji did not answer her question; instead, he stepped back, looking at her seriously: 'Senior Sister Su, I'd like to ask you something first—why would an Inner Disciple Senior Fellow appear at this desolate place in the sect's Rear Mountain so late?' His gaze was calm, yet carried a hint of probing. 'Could it be... Senior Sister also has secrets she doesn't want others to know about?'"

"By the water pool, moonlight fell like silver gauze, stretching their figures long. Su Qingyao suddenly let out a light laugh, that laughter carrying几分自嘲,几分释然.

'My secrets?' She slowly walked to a blue stone by the pool's edge and sat down. 'Do you know why the Han family broke off our engagement?'

Chen Ji was slightly taken aback. He only knew Su Qingyao had once been betrothed to the Han family, but had no idea there was such a hidden story.

'Three years ago, the Han family old master personally visited, and in front of my master said—Su Qingyao marrying into the Han family would only disgrace Han Lie's talent.' Su Qingyao's voice was terrifyingly calm. 'Because I'm 'husband-killing,' I would hinder Han Lie from becoming the Xuanwu Sect heir.'"

dialogue.content:
"Chen Ji fell silent. He looked at Su Qingyao's straight yet lonely silhouette under the moonlight, and suddenly understood something. This Inner Disciple Senior Fellow who appeared glorious on the surface was actually enduring no less malice and bullying behind the scenes than anyone else.

'Senior Sister.' He spoke softly, his voice losing some timidity, gaining some sincerity. 'I always thought you were the most dazzling existence in the Tianqing Sect. Only now do I realize we're all just pitiful creatures they've stepped on.'

Su Qingyao turned her head back; under the moonlight, a complex gleam flickered in her eyes. 'So... you too?'"

text.content:
"Chen Ji did not speak, simply slowly sitting down not far from Su Qingyao. Neither spoke again; only the sounds of night wind brushing across the water and endless insect chirps filled their ears.

After an unknown length of time, Su Qingyao suddenly stretched out her hand, pointing to the faintly glowing spot in Chen Ji's embrace: 'The thing you're hiding... is a Tianji Record Fragment, isn't it?'

Chen Ji's whole body jolted, his pupils contracting sharply. He instinctively wanted to deny it, but he met Su Qingyao's calm, water-like eyes—those held no greed, no threat, only a strange understanding."

choice.prompt: "Su Qingyao has pierced the secret in his embrace with a single phrase. What choice should Chen Ji make?"

choices.description: "Completely trust Su Qingyao, laying out everything about the Tianji Record Fragment's existence, establishing a true alliance."
choices.visible_reward: "Gain a powerful ally, eliminate a potential threat"
choices.risk_hint: "If Su Qingyao betrays, it will be utter ruin"

text.content: "Chen Ji took a deep breath, slowly taking out that turtle shell from his embrace. The cracks were shocking under the moonlight, yet emanated an ancient and mysterious aura. 'Senior Sister is right—this is a page of the Tianji Record... It lets me see the future, yet it also devours my life little by little.' He smiled bitterly. 'Han Lie wants to kill me, perhaps not just because I'm in his way.'"

choices.memory_label: 苏青瑶得知天机录残页的存在，并承诺保守秘密

choices.description: "Admit to having something special, but conceal key details, leaving room for maneuver for both parties."
choices.risk_hint: "Su Qingyao might have already seen through more"

text.content: "Chen Ji hesitated for a moment, then pressed his hand against the turtle shell in his embrace: 'Senior Sister's eyes are like torches. I do have some... special encounters. But this secret involves too much; I must apologize for not being able to lay everything bare now.' He looked at Su Qingyao seriously. 'But I can promise Senior Sister—if the day comes when I can speak, you will be the first to know.'"

choices.description: "Neither confirm nor deny, letting Su Qingyao guess for herself, maintaining absolute mystique."
choices.risk_hint: "Su Qingyao might distance herself from then on"

text.content:
"Chen Ji did not speak, simply quietly looking at Su Qingyao. Moonlight cast deep shadows in his eyes. Silence, sometimes, carries more power than any words.

After a moment, Su Qingyao sighed lightly: 'Never mind, I shouldn't have asked.' She stood up, tidying the hair blown乱 by the night wind. 'What happened tonight, I will never tell anyone.'"

dialogue.content:
"Su Qingyao looked at Chen Ji, her gaze losing some scrutiny, gaining some gentleness. She suddenly spoke: 'At tomorrow's Sect Competition, Han Lie will definitely make a move publicly.' She paused, her voice carrying a hint of warmth not easily察觉. 'If you need, I can attend as your backup.'

Chen Ji was slightly stunned, raising his head to look at her. Under the moonlight, Su Qingyao's expression was more serious than ever.

'Although you and I have never had dealings, tonight...' She微微别过脸. 'Tonight's matter, consider it a debt I owe you. If you ever need help in the future, I, Su Qingyao, will never stand by indifferently.'"

text.content:
"Chen Ji looked at this woman who was cold as ice yet revealed her true heart under the moonlight, and an indescribable warmth surged in his heart. He suddenly grinned, that smile completely different from his usual timidity: 'Senior Sister Su, tonight you saved me once; I've noted it. If anyone dares to move against you in the future—' He paused, a sharp, cold light flickering in his eyes. 'Even if he's the number one prodigy of the Xuanwu Sect, I, Chen Ji, will never sit by and do nothing.'

This was the first time he addressed himself by name in front of Su Qingyao, rather than 'waste' or 'servant.'

Su Qingyao froze for a moment, then the corner of her mouth slightly lifted, forming a shallow but genuine smile: 'Alright, I've noted it.'"

choice.prompt: "The Moonlit Oath is formed. How should Chen Ji respond to this trial-forged bond?"

choices.description: "Establish the agreement in a formal manner, laying the foundation for future cooperation."
choices.visible_reward: "Establish a true alliance with Su Qingyao"
choices.risk_hint: "Might lose trust if unable to fulfill"

dialogue.content:
"Chen Ji spoke seriously: 'Senior Sister Su, although I, Chen Ji, am a useless servant, I still understand the principle of repaying kindness a hundredfold. Today's oath is engraved in my heart; I will repay it in the future.' He clasped his hands in a salute, his posture so solemn one wouldn't think he was a servant disciple.

Su Qingyao watched him, the smile in her eyes deepening: 'Very well, then I'll be watching your performance at the Sect Competition tomorrow. Don't disappoint me.'"

choices.memory_label: 陈机与苏青瑶正式结盟，约定在大比上互相扶持

choices.description: "Respond in a relaxed manner, showing Chen Ji's humorous side, drawing closer to Su Qingyao."

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji suddenly grinned: 'Senior Sister Su, I've just realized something.' He playfully blinked. 'Tonight you saved me, so I owe you a favor; but if I defeat Han Lie at tomorrow's competition, won't the news of waste defeating genius also somewhat cleanse your humiliation of being jilted?' He said with perfect seriousness. 'In that way, we're actually mutually beneficial.'"

text.content:
"The night wind grew cool, the moon slanted westward. Su Qingyao took out a jade bottle from her embrace and handed it to Chen Ji: 'This is healing medicine; use it first.' When Chen Ji tried to decline, she raised her hand to stop him. 'Don't be polite with me. You have a fight tomorrow; you can't go on stage covered in wounds.'

Chen Ji took the jade bottle, his fingertips touching the cool jade surface, and a warmth spread in his heart. He suddenly remembered something, fishing out that turtle shell from his embrace. After hesitating, he pointed to a tiny crack on it: 'Senior Sister, you asked what I was hiding... This crack was caused by Han Lie's palm strike tonight.'"

dialogue.content:
"Su Qingyao leaned in for a closer look, her brow creasing slightly. She gently touched the turtle shell's surface with her fingertips; a faint sting came through—that was some ancient prohibition's rejection of a stranger.

'This crack...' She murmured. 'Seems like some seal was forcibly pried open a crack.' She raised her head, her gaze carrying more gravity. 'Chen Ji, I don't know what fate you carry, but if you trust me, come to my meditation pavilion in three days. I once saw records of similar prohibitions in an ancient text; perhaps I can find a way to repair it.'"

text.content:
"Chen Ji nodded solemnly and tucked the turtle shell back into his embrace.

Su Qingyao turned to look toward the direction of the cliff top, her robes fluttering gently in the night wind: 'It's getting late; I'll send you up.' She glanced back at Chen Ji, the corner of her mouth slightly lifting. 'But I don't want others to see me, a堂堂 Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, supporting a little servant up the mountain path late at night. If that got out, my reputation would be ruined.'

The words were spoken seriously, yet her eyes clearly carried a hint of mischief.

Chen Ji froze for a moment, then laughed out loud—instantly, he realized this cold-as-ice Inner Disciple Senior Fellow also had a playful side deep in her bones."
